usdRate.sourceName: Bank of Mongolia rate (via Trading Economics)
usdRate.note: Secondary source (Trading Economics, Bank of Mongolia rate) because the Bank of Mongolia rate page renders by script; the Bank of Mongolia home page showed 3,598.99 on 2 November 2026; World Bank average for 2025 was 3,545.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: National Statistics Office of Mongolia CPI (via Trading Economics)
inflation_cpi.note: 12.9% year on year in September 2026 (12.5% in August, 13.0% in July); secondary source because the NSO site renders by script.

inflation_projection.sourceName: Bank of Mongolia 6% (+/-2) target; IMF WEO projections (6.6-8.2% for 2028-2031)
inflation_projection.note: CPI averaged about 9.5% over 2021-2025 and the 6% target is rarely met, so we plan with 7%, in line with IMF medium-term projections.

policy_rate.sourceName: Bank of Mongolia policy rate (via Trading Economics)
policy_rate.note: Raised from 12% to 12.5% in August 2026 and held on 17 September 2026.

savings_account_rate.note: Bank deposit rate pages (rendered by script) could not be read; no published typical savings-account rate found.

fdr_3m_rate.note: Bank term deposit rate pages could not be read; see bank_deposit_avg_rate.

fdr_1y_rate.note: Bank term deposit rate pages could not be read; see bank_deposit_avg_rate.

dps_rate.note: No published rate for monthly recurring deposits found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: Bank of Mongolia average deposit interest rate (via Trading Economics)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: 12.04% in September 2026 (12.02% in August); World Bank FR.INR.DPST shows 6.6% for 2021.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals found.

tbill_91d_rate.note: No current domestic treasury bill yield found; Trading Economics has no Mongolian government bond yield series.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No current domestic 5-year government bond yield found.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No current domestic 10-year government bond yield found.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Mongolia, taxes on personal income (reviewed 8 June 2026)
tax_bank_interest.note: Interest is property income taxed at 10% for residents (withheld at source); 20% for non-residents; a special 5% rate applies to interest on purchased debt instruments.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists; interest on purchased debt instruments is taxed at a special 5% rate (PwC).

deposit_insurance_limit.note: A mandatory deposit insurance scheme exists (Law on Insurance of Bank Deposits, 2013; Deposit Insurance Corporation of Mongolia), but its website renders by script and we could not read the current limit.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or published typical credit card rate found.

equity_return_low.sourceName: MSE TOP-20 index record (via Trading Economics)
equity_return_low.note: The index rose from a 10,486 low to about 66,800 (Oct 2026) but is volatile and concentrated, so the low case is below the deposit rate.

equity_return_base.sourceName: After-tax average deposit rate 10.8% plus a modest premium; MSE TOP-20 record
equity_return_base.note: Base set about 2 points above the after-tax deposit rate, under the 4-point limit, because the market is small and concentrated despite a strong 10-year run.

equity_return_high.sourceName: MSE TOP-20 index record (via Trading Economics)
equity_return_high.note: High case closer to the index's strong record of the past decade (+34% in the year to October 2026).

gold_return_low.sourceName: US-dollar gold trend; tugrik depreciation (World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF)
gold_return_low.note: Gold can stall for years; low case assumes little tugrik depreciation.

gold_return_base.sourceName: US-dollar gold trend plus expected tugrik depreciation
gold_return_base.note: About 4% dollar gold trend plus about 5% a year tugrik depreciation from the inflation gap with the US.

gold_return_high.sourceName: US-dollar gold trend plus expected tugrik depreciation
gold_return_high.note: High case for a strong gold cycle with faster depreciation.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Bank of Mongolia average deposit rate after 10% tax
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case if rates fall back as inflation eases. Safe MNT rates: average bank deposit rate 12.04% (Sep 2026, Bank of Mongolia), 10% tax on interest, policy rate 12.5%; no retail treasury bills or savings bonds found.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Bank of Mongolia average deposit rate after 10% tax
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case just under the after-tax average deposit rate (12.04% x 0.9 = 10.8%). Safe MNT rates: average bank deposit rate 12.04% (Sep 2026, Bank of Mongolia), 10% tax on interest, policy rate 12.5%; no retail treasury bills or savings bonds found.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: Bank of Mongolia average deposit rate and policy rate
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case for longer term deposits above the average rate. Safe MNT rates: average bank deposit rate 12.04% (Sep 2026, Bank of Mongolia), 10% tax on interest, policy rate 12.5%; no retail treasury bills or savings bonds found.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The Financial Regulatory Commission site renders by script; no claim settlement ratio found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published term life premium rates or premium guides in tugrik found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums by age found.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure, SH.XPD.OOPC.CH.ZS)

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: NSO CPI (via Trading Economics); no medical CPI read
goal_inflation_health.note: With about half of health spending out of pocket, we plan 2 points above long-run inflation for medical costs.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: NSO CPI (via Trading Economics); no education CPI read
goal_inflation_education.note: We plan 1 point above long-run inflation for school and university fees.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN)

life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years derived from expected age at death by current age; secondary source because the WHO GHO API was unavailable.

support_ratio.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024, medium variant (via populationpyramid.net); World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: OADR 8.6 in 2025 (World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL), 14.8 in 2040 and 22.8 in 2065 (UN WPP 2024 medium variant via populationpyramid.net).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: General Office of Social Insurance, old-age pension insurance
retirement_age_default.note: Pension age rises with birth year: men from 60 (born 1957 or earlier) to 65 (born 1977 or later); women from 55 (born 1962 or earlier) to 60 for those born 1982, 62 for 1990 and 65 for 2002 or later. 65 applies to men born after 1976; women born 1976-2001 have a lower age (about 58.5-64.75). Early pension on request at 60 (men) or 55 (women) with enough contribution years.

retirement_age_government.note: No official page with the current civil-service retirement age was readable; civil servants draw the same social insurance pension.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Bank of Mongolia average deposit rate after 10% tax
retirement_return_low.note: Low case if deposit rates fall as inflation eases. Safe MNT rates: average bank deposit rate 12.04% (Sep 2026, Bank of Mongolia), 10% tax on interest, policy rate 12.5%; no retail treasury bills or savings bonds found.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: Bank of Mongolia average deposit rate after 10% tax
retirement_return_base.note: Base case below the after-tax average deposit rate (10.8%). Safe MNT rates: average bank deposit rate 12.04% (Sep 2026, Bank of Mongolia), 10% tax on interest, policy rate 12.5%; no retail treasury bills or savings bonds found.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Bank of Mongolia average deposit rate after 10% tax
retirement_return_high.note: High case near the after-tax deposit rate on longer terms. Safe MNT rates: average bank deposit rate 12.04% (Sep 2026, Bank of Mongolia), 10% tax on interest, policy rate 12.5%; no retail treasury bills or savings bonds found.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Mix of tugrik deposits and local equity
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: About 40% equity at the low case, 60% deposits.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Mix of tugrik deposits and local equity
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: About half equity at 13% and half deposits near 10.5%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Mix of tugrik deposits and local equity
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: About 60% equity at the high case and 40% deposits.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: The social welfare agency site was not reachable, so the amount of any non-contributory pension for elderly people without a social insurance pension could not be confirmed. Minimum contributory old-age pension is MNT 769,000 a month (Social Insurance General Office).

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Eligibility ages for the social welfare pension could not be confirmed from an official page.

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory gratuity per year of service found; the Labour Law provides severance on dismissal, but we could not read its current terms.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: General Office of Social Insurance, old-age pension insurance
public_pension_scheme.note: Social insurance pension: 8.5% employee + 8.5% employer (11.5% for voluntary contributors); pension age rising to 65 for both sexes; full pension needs 22 years 3 months of contributions in 2026, rising to 25 years by 2037 (10-19 years gives a partial pension of 0.1875% of average wage per contribution month); full pension = average wage of the best 60 months in the last 20 years x (45% + 0.125% per month beyond 20 years; 0.167% from 2029); minimum full pension MNT 769,000 a month (partial MNT 652,400). The page describes no automatic inflation indexation, so inflationLinked is false; tax treatment not stated.

dps.note: Banks offer savings plans with regular top-ups; no published average rate.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals found.

tbill_91d.note: No current retail treasury bill found.

tbond_5y.note: No current domestic issue found for individuals.

tbond_10y.note: No current domestic issue found for individuals.

equity_fund.note: A few licensed funds and shares trade on the Mongolian Stock Exchange.

gold.note: Gold bars are sold by banks and dealers.

insuranceComplaints.name: Financial Regulatory Commission (FRC)
insuranceComplaints.note: Complaints about insurers go to the regulator.
